$comment: Conforms to the AI Blueprint file layout and entry format (ai-blueprint.dev/docs).
Hand-authored: the Blueprint CLI is NOT installed and is not a dependency.
This file is the policy a new agent session reads before touching anything.

project.name: judge-judy
project.tagline: Build the platform that will judge you.

context.deep_reference_note: 330KB. Not loaded by default. Read the section named in the overview, never the whole folder.

verify.$comment: Two gates at different times. spec runs now, before any app code exists. app runs at every break.

spec.needs: stdlib only - no venv, no Docker, no network

expectations.given_inputs: fixtures.json SHA-256 == 252896BC...; spec.md, run.py, context.txt, example.dogfood.toml present
expectations.run_py: 7 checks (3 T1, 4 T2), TIMEOUT=10, fixture_titles n=3, always returns 0
expectations.census: every count in project-overview.md re-derived from fixtures.json: 8/30/21/9/40/41/126, histogram 8@2 26@3 3@4 4@5, mass 126, criteria order, jdg_07, n=1 judges, 1 component / 71 nodes
expectations.build_clock: window == 69h, BREAK-1..4 on the cumulative clock at H+14/H+30/H+40/H+54, freeze at H+65, tier hours agree with the features, phase headers agree with checklist items
expectations.spec_integrity: all bible section citations resolve, findings tallies match the ledger, overview < 20000 bytes, questions closed, exactly one in-flight feature

spec.run_it: after ANY edit to blueprint/ or AGENTS.md, and before trusting a number quoted in a document

app.$comment: Not runnable until FEAT-01. run.py always exits 0, so parse its report body rather than gating on status.
steps: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d

tier_breaks.decides: T2 green, all 4 T2 checks passing?
how much of T4 is green?

break_protocol: docker compose down -v && up, network off
python run.py .dogfood.toml — real output, never edited
update the slippage ledger in bible/08 §1c with actual vs planned
decide the tier claim and write it down, naming any gap in plain words

freeze.$comment: Verification, acceptance report, video, commit. No features. A claim of T4 with half-working endpoints scores worse than an honest T3.

review.$comment: Solo build, 69 hours. Review gates on because the brief scores defensibility, and a solo AI-assisted build is exactly where a wrong assumption survives longest.

rules.new_code_only: No application code was authored before the window. The bible and this blueprint layer are planning documents. Dependencies and environment setup are explicitly permitted by the spec.
rules.denials_are_403: A denied request returns a literal 401/403 with an empty body and no Location header. Never a 302. run.py follows redirects.
rules.generated_not_transcribed: Every number in a shipped document is produced by code. A hand-typed census table is how six of our twelve findings happened.
rules.verify_against_the_installation: Every claim about library behaviour is executed, not recalled. F-11 was a documented default that was backwards.
rules.no_tuning_to_a_target: Published targets are context, not an objective. Constants chosen a priori stay chosen; the full sensitivity curve ships beside any single number.
